title: i18n-kit source catalog
description: The authored source-language catalog for one namespace. This file is the source of truth. Everything under the build directory is generated from it.

namespace.description: Namespace name. Matches the filename without extension.

sourceLocale.description: BCP 47 tag of the language these messages are written in.

propertyNames.description: Dot-separated key, at least two segments, lowercase snake within a segment. This grammar is chosen so that replacing dots with underscores yields a valid Android resource name and a valid Chrome message name.

message.description: ICU MessageFormat text in the source language.

comment.description: What this string is for, where it appears, and who is speaking. Effectively required: it affects translation quality more than model choice does. Not listed in `required` here because the COMMENT_MISSING lint enforces it as a ratchet, an error for new keys and a counted warning for a pre-existing backlog, which a schema cannot express. `i18n add` refuses to create a key without one.

context.description: Where the string appears. Selects register: imperative for buttons, noun phrase for titles, polite forms for errors.

class.description: How literal the translation must be. 'ui' is faithful with sacred placeholders and hard length limits. 'marketing' permits transcreation: adapted idioms, rewritten headlines, impact over literal wording. 'seo' preserves search intent and keyword prominence.

placeholders.description: Every argument named in the message. Checked against the parsed ICU: declaring one that does not appear, or omitting one that does, is an error.

keywords.description: SEO only. The primary keyword must survive into every translation.

measure.description: display-width counts East Asian wide characters as two. Measuring string length instead makes every CJK locale look far shorter than it renders.

maxLength.description: A hard constraint the author asserted. Exceeding it is an error, not a warning.

tier.description: 'critical' strings may get a stronger model and a second review pass.

sensitive.description: Never send this message, its comment, or its examples to a translation provider. It must be translated by a human.

targets.description: Which export targets this message belongs to. Omitted means all enabled targets. Lets one catalog serve platforms that do not share every string.

deprecated.description: Deprecated keys are skipped by export and retained in translations until removed.

type.description: 'tag' is a rich-text element the runtime maps to a caller-supplied handler.

example.description: A realistic value. Used to render the message during validation and to give a translator concrete context. Never put real personal data here.

desc.description: What this argument means. A device name reads very differently from a file name.

doNotTranslate.description: The substituted value is a proper noun or user-chosen text that must not be altered or transliterated.
